I propose the "Little Warrior" game. Here are the rules :

For 15 GP, you choose an amount beetween 20 and 80. We both have five cards in hands, each round 
both of us can ask to change one card, this for three rounds, so that we try to have the longest 
possible serie, the best is a five cards serie (goblin-ogre-elemental-lich-dragon).

After the three rounds, we both show our cards. If your serie is longer than mine, you win the 
amount choosen plus a bonus related to the length of your serie. Otherwise if you loose, you must 
pay me that amount. And if it is a draw, shall we play again, it's a deal, no ?!

Advice : Make the lower line of your first inventory page free, so you will easily see your cards. 
Play with your inventory open on the page where you have your cards !

I propose the "Pokrun" game. Here are the rules :

For 20 GP, you choose an amount beetween 20 and 100. We both have five five cards in hands, each 
round both of us can ask to change one card, this for three rounds, so that we try to have the best 
possible combination, as shown below from the weakest to the strongest :

1) 2 identical cards.
2) 2 identical cards plus 2 identical cards.
3) 3 identical cards.
4) 3 identical cards plus 2 identical cards.
5) 4 identical cards.
6) 5 identical cards.

After the three rounds, we both show our cards. If your combination is better than mine, you win 
the amount choosen plus a bonus related to the worth of your combination. Otherwise if you loose, 
you must pay me that amount. And if it is a draw, we'll have a drink together !

Advice : Make the lower line of your first inventory page free, so you will easily see your cards. 
Play with your inventory open on the page where you have your cards !

I propose the "Battle" game, which is played a lot in taverns, because of its simplicity. Here are the rules :

For 10 GP, you choose an amount beetween 10 and 50. We both have ten cards in hands. Each round we both choose one and put it on the table. The player who placed the strongest card win one victory.

After the ten rounds, if you won more often than me, I give you the amount (in GP) you've choosen. But if I won more, that's you who will give me that amount. If it is a draw, we will salute each other.
